pulse.currentFocus: Session 329 ran the three-agent mega-audit, locked an 8-phase founder-approved improvement plan, and shipped phases 1-3: sitewide derived counts + a 125-page banner-parity gate, the Desk cross-day slug-rerun class closed (with honest consolidation of the live 3-day duplicate), registry/status truth reconciled (game-registry 8→11, Scriptorium sparked, Franchise Architect shard restored, ignis-roi unfrozen + ceilinged), and the micro-feedback loop transmitting anonymous usefulness votes for the first time. build:check 370/370.
pulse.nextMilestone: Phase 4a IA consolidation: fold /nervous-system/ into /studio-pulse/, unify the intel pill nav across the 11-page intelligence cluster, real shell on /stats/*, nav entries for /status/ + /search/, and the structural sitemap fix (vault-member EXCLUDE substring bug + robots-noindex skip). Then 4b analysis-gated merges per D-S329.7.
blockers: content promotion still depends on a route-provenance probe run from an unchallenged vantage for the PRODUCTION half of the receipt: CI is bot-challenged at the production origin and cannot produce the live route evidence the split-release guard requires. (A CI-reachable build-attestation vantage was added session 322 but deliberately cannot satisfy this gate.)

identity: the provider chain is live and verified (discovery JSON, authorize redirect, JWKS, and the revocation route all answer correctly as of session 321). The production promotion is held only on the real-provider journey, whose remaining leg is a founder passkey ceremony — hardware-key enrollment is founder-reserved by CANON-019 and is deliberately not automatable.
rollback architecture: the GitHub Pages warm origin still follows mutable main; D-S303 requires explicit founder authorization before migrating to an immutable verified generation.
IGNIS freshness: stale in a studio-ops portfolio artifact this repo cannot write; resolve upstream rather than backdating.
The Dispatch has zero confirmed subscribers until the founder clicks the double-opt-in confirmation email.

now: [S329][IA/P1] Phase 4a — uncontroversial IA consolidation. Fold `/nervous-system/` → `/studio-pulse/` (redirect stub + footer-manifest + nav-orphan/sitemap regen); unify the `.intel-suite` pill nav across the full 11-page intelligence cluster (currently 3); give `/stats/` + `/stats/ecosystem/` the real site shell and move `build-ecosystem-stats-page.mjs` into the build chain; footer Resources entries for `/status/` + `/search/`; sitemap workflow fix (the `vault-member` EXCLUDE substring accidentally drops `/projects/vault-member/` + `/journal/building-vault-membership/`; add a structural robots-noindex skip covering `/vault-treasury/`, `/docs/visual-proof/`, and superseded Desk stories).

[S329][IA/P1] Phase 4b — analysis-gated merges. Per founder directive: write a merge-analysis per cluster to DECISIONS before merging. Membership funnel 5→2 (`/membership/` canonical + `/vaultsparked/` comparison; `/membership-value/`, `/vault-portal/`, `/join/` → redirects/rows); one leaderboard home (fold `/vault-wall/` + `/community/` leaderboard sections); orphan link-or-retire batch (`/notebook/`, `/ip/`, `/share/`, `/brand/system/`, `/ignis/roi/`, `/security/trusted-types/`, legacy `/franchise-architect/` + `/solara/` roots); `/projects/` catalog 11→20.

[S329][SEC/P1] Phase 5 — security. Fix the two "unverified" posture controls in `build-security-posture.mjs` evidence resolution (csp-audit + supply-chain) → posture "attention"→clean; Turnstile on contact + Desk dispatch (edge siteverify FIRST, then client embed — D-S318.2 one release unit; e2e proving token-less submit rejected); build `/ask-founders/` (founder-approved; the Worker rate-limit route already exists).

[S329][COST/P1] Phase 6 — token/compute. vault-narrative → free Hetzner `desk-inference.chat()` (Anthropic shape isolated at 3 points; raise maxTokens 220→≥512, thinking:false; workflow secret swap; grounding post-check) — kills all scheduled paid LLM spend; `refresh-live-data.yml` → `runDerivedBuilds()` slim profile + coverage assertion; monthly journal-revival lane on Hetzner inference (founder-approved, draft-for-review, never auto-publish) + wire `update-journal-dates.mjs` into build.

[S329][INFRA/P1] Reconcile `propagate-nav.mjs` before any future run. Its hand-maintained NAV_GAMES/NAV_PROJECTS arrays and ambient-script refs are stale vs live pages — a bare run clobbered 126 pages (games dropdown regressed, footer `/stats/` link dropped, hashed ambient shells replaced with `.bundle.js`; reverted in S329). Derive the arrays from game-registry/catalog or assert parity with `derive-game-nav` before it may write again.

[S329][SIL][GATE/P2] Build `check-receipt-ordering` — turn the receipt-after-final-build rule into a gate. The mobile-runtime and visual receipts bind source hashes; assert those hashes match the CURRENT built tree so a receipt captured before the last build re-stamp fails structurally instead of by discipline (D-S329.8).

[S329][PERF/P2] Phase 7 — perf. Stale-shell prune (grep JS-resident refs first, D-S317.8); 187KB style.css weight pass; Lighthouse perf floor raise from 0.76 to measured headroom; visual-QA PNG retention policy (472 + 4/day); franchise-architect INP pointerenter fix (p75 640ms).

[S329][ELITE/P2] Phase 8 — elite features. Eternal Intelligence gets a real model call (reuse ask-ignis tokenMeter/cache/persona; function deploy before portal cascade); portal member→studio feedback panel (page_feedback reuse first); agent actions API + Obelisk agent tokens (CANON-048 completion); declare the 17 `.cache/` artifacts in the evidence graph; Desk visual receipt per story (rank 98) + visual-diversity memory (rank 90).
next: [NEXT][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet. Add stable fact rows and validated factRefs joining factual evidence to stances and visual anchors; publish a per-story public-safe argument map and one-click critique packet with no runtime model spend.

[NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Field-vitals freshness closure. Surface observed-through/stale-days, restore a fresh post-S262 RUM window, and bind cohort verdicts to a release SHA so fresh generatedAt can never imply fresh field evidence.
